api:
OV.Screens (additions; everything else unchanged):
- trimToStr(missionSoldier, store?) -> [removed item ids]. While loadout weight > stats.str, it moves extras into store ({item:n}, mutated) in this order: high_explosive, proximity_grenade, the 2nd electro_flare (pack), smoke_grenade, motion_scanner, grenades beyond the first, ammo beyond 1 compatible clip, the last grenade, and finally the belt flare. The weapon and 1 clip always stay.
- buildQuickMission(q): now builds mission.craftItems = quickStore(...) first, then runs trimToStr on every soldier (the removed items go to the craft floor / the Equipar store), then medPicks, then spareClip.
- lossCauses(B) -> {enemy, friendly, wounds, other, total, main, tip, weak, race,
  ff: [{victim, killer, how: 'shot'|'blast'|'self', reaction: bool}],
  squad, aliens, tip2: 'scr.db.tip.wounds'|null, costly: bool}.
  - tip priority: 'scr.db.tip.outnumbered' (squad < aliens and squad < 6), then 'scr.db.tip.weapons', then 'scr.db.tip.friendly.shot' (most friendly deaths were shots), then 'scr.db.tip.' + main.
  - reaction is read from u.deathSide when the engine records it.
- lossNotes(B, result, {campaign?}): the friendly-fire line names who hit whom, up to 3 entries, then «e mais N». The tip is shown on a loss, and also on a win when costly (≥ 50 % of the squad dead, or ≥ 3 dead on Recruta), titled «Vitória cara — dica para a próxima:» with class .scr-tip.costly; tip2 is appended after it.
- New i18n keys:
  - scr.db.ff.shot, scr.db.ff.shot.r, scr.db.ff.blast, scr.db.ff.self, scr.db.ff.more
  - scr.db.tip.friendly.shot, scr.db.tip.outnumbered ({n},{aliens}), scr.db.tip.costly
  - Reworded: scr.db.friendly.one/.other, scr.howto.tu.body.
summary:
Persona round 3 screens fixes: all 6 findings re-checked and fixed at the root, each with a regression check.

1. FIXED (major, «Ainda presente»): the Quick Battle starting kit ignored Força (month 4: Plasma Pesado + clips + 2 flares + explosive left 5–6 of 10 soldiers overweight).
   - Root cause: loadoutFor builds a fixed kit, and only the medikit and spare clip ever checked Força.
   - Fix: new trimToStr runs on every soldier in buildQuickMission. It uses the same rule as Auto-equipar: extras go back to the Skyranger store until weight ≤ Força, so they stay available in Equipar.
   - Result: the month 4 night battleship case now has 0 of 10 overweight.
2. FIXED (iPad night flare overweight): same root cause and fix as finding 1. The 2nd flare is now removed when Força is short, as the persona suggested. The Local de Terror night case (seed 91277) has 0 overweight, and every soldier keeps the belt flare at night.
3. FIXED (Enter after «Aleatória» rolled a new seed instead of starting): keys() now treats the focused «Aleatória» button like the segment buttons, so Enter starts the battle. Space still activates the button, and Enter on «Voltar» still goes back.
4. FIXED (friendly-fire tip always talked about explosives):
   - lossCauses now sorts each friendly death into a shot, an explosion or a self-kill. The engine tags rockets as shots too, so the shooter's weapon and ammo decide: an explosive radius or an empty launcher counts as an explosion.
   - The debrief line names who hit whom («Meera Nair ← tiro de reação de Matthew Nguyen»).
   - A new tip, scr.db.tip.friendly.shot, covers reaction fire and the line of fire.
   - When the squad was smaller than the alien force (fewer than 6 soldiers), the outnumbered tip takes priority.
   - The «(reação)» label only appears once the engine records the side at death (sim patch in open_issues).
5. FIXED (no tip on a costly win): the tip now also shows on a win where ≥ 50 % of the squad died, or ≥ 3 died on Recruta, titled «Vitória cara — dica para a próxima:». A 2nd tip about wounds is added when someone bled to death with a medikit on board. This applies to Quick Battle and to the campaign debrief (campaign_ui calls lossNotes).
6. FIXED («Como Jogar» explained the path preview only by colour): scr.howto.tu.body now describes the shapes:
   - ● ponto cheio: reaches the tile and still has TU for the reserved shot (with no reserve, for a quick shot).
   - ○ ponto oco, linha tracejada: reaches the tile, but can no longer take that shot.
   - ✕ cruz: not enough TU.
   - Colours are named as secondary, including the colour-blind palette. The label suffix the persona asked for in the Battlescape is battle_ui (open_issues).

Tests: new tools/tests/screens_persona_r3.test.js (9 tests, < 0.1 s). node tools/test.js --strict --i18n: 726 passed, 0 failed.

QA:
- New qa/persona_r3_screens.mjs: 54/54 checks at 1440×900, 1024×576, iPad 834×1194 and 1194×834 (touch).
- qa/screens_check.mjs: 49/49. qa/persona_r2_shell.mjs: 122/122.
- I looked at every screenshot (debrief, Como Jogar including the colour-blind palette, Equipar, briefing): all legible, every soldier within Força, no ⟦missing⟧ keys.
- qa/full_campaign.mjs fails outside my files (open_issues).
deviations: Enter fix: I kept the explicit focus list in keys() (body, start button, «Aleatória» and segment buttons) instead of «any button except Voltar». The existing source-regex test in tools/tests/shell_persona_r2.test.js (not mine) pins that exact expression, and the list now covers every button in the form except «Voltar».

The trim order removes the explosive before the 2nd flare, the reverse of the persona's suggested order. At night, flares matter more and High Explosive is the heavier item that causes friendly fire. The persona's night case (rifle + 2 flares, no explosive) still drops the 2nd flare first, as suggested.
The «(reação)» marker is only shown when the unit has u.deathSide. The engine does not record it yet (sim patch in open_issues); until then the line reads «tiro de X» without inventing a reaction.

I first created my regression test as tools/tests/shell_persona_r3.test.js. Another fixer then wrote their own file with the same name and replaced mine. My tests now live in tools/tests/screens_persona_r3.test.js; I did not touch their file.
open_issues: Sim patch (owner of js/sim/battle/combat.js), so the debrief can label friendly reaction-fire deaths exactly: in killUnit, next to `u.deathTurn = B.turn | 0;`, add `u.deathSide = B.side || null;`. screens.js lossCauses already reads it (reaction = a friendly shot while B.side !== 'xcom').

Battle UI (owner of js/ui/battle_ui.js), part of the colour-blind finding: when the path destination step is 'reserve' (○) and S.B.reserve is 'none' (the preview falls back to the quick-shot reserve), append «· sem UT para disparar» to the path label. Add a pt-PT.hud key such as hud.path.noShot = 'sem UT para disparar'. Optional, from the iPad finding: show the overweight TU penalty in the HUD (e.g. «UT 46/51» or a ⚖ icon) when a soldier started overweight. Quick Battle kits now start within Força, so this is less urgent.

qa/full_campaign.mjs fails outside my files: «derrota inesperada: council» and «batalha jogada e relatório da campanha». Per its log, after the first crash the night «Equipa no local» dialog (craftArrived) sent Skyranger-1 back to base, so no battle was ever played and the council ended the game. This matches fixer B's in-progress geo_ui change (night arrival / «Esperar pelo dia» by default); the bot's choice in that dialog, or that default, needs updating there.
File-name collision: tools/tests/shell_persona_r3.test.js now belongs to the shell/strategy fixer. My round 3 screens tests are in tools/tests/screens_persona_r3.test.js.
